cloud.when_the_last_player: When the last player disconnects from your server, Zircon Cloud initiates a graceful 15-minute idle countdown. If no players join, the game container is suspended (Pause-to-Sleep). All chunk state, entities, and inventories are flushed and saved to disk. When a player clicks PLAY in the Zircon Launcher, our edge proxy wakes the instance seamlessly for your players.

faq.how_does_zircon_automatically: How does Zircon automatically sync Minecraft mods?
faq.when_you_pick_a: When you pick a server and hit PLAY, the Zircon Launcher connects to the server and retrieves its cryptographic mod manifest (BOM). It compares this against your local instance folder, verifies SHA-512 hashes and CurseForge fingerprints against official repositories, and downloads any missing or updated mods automatically.
faq.can_i_use_curseforge: Can I use CurseForge or Modrinth to find and download mods?
faq.yes_zircon_natively_supports: Yes! Zircon natively supports both Modrinth and CurseForge with zero API keys required. Whether configuring an instance in the Server Manager or playing on a server, mods from both repositories are handled seamlessly with automatic hash verification.
faq.can_i_create_singleplayer: Can I create single-player offline instances?
faq.yes_the_launcher_includes: Yes. The launcher includes a full offline instance manager. You can create local single-player instances with choice of Minecraft version (1.16 through latest), mod loader (Fabric, Quilt, Forge, NeoForge), custom RAM allocation, and local mods.
faq.how_do_the_skin: How do the Skin Customizer and Community Skin Library work?
faq.the_skin_selector_lets: The skin selector lets you pick from saved skins or upload a custom PNG, preview your character in live rotating 3D (with Steve and Alex geometry options), and sync directly to Mojang. In addition, the Community Skin Library lets you browse thousands of trending community skins fetched live via API and apply them with one click.
faq.zircon_server_manager_multiplexes: Zircon Server Manager multiplexes both standard Minecraft game traffic (port 25565) and HTTP REST mod manifest traffic on the same single port. Players simply enter your server address once (e.g. play.example.com) and the launcher fetches the mod manifest and connects the game over port 25565 without requiring secondary ports.
faq.how_do_i_access: How do I access the Admin Web Dashboard?
faq.when_you_start_the: When you start the server manager, an admin password is generated and printed to your console. Open your browser and navigate to http://localhost:25564 (or your private IP) to log in. For security, keep port 25564 local or behind a VPN/reverse proxy.
faq.how_does_the_server: How does the server sleep/wake mode work?
faq.when_all_players_leave: When all players leave the server, Zircon gracefully pauses the Minecraft server process to conserve CPU and RAM. When any player clicks PLAY in their launcher, a pre-join intent wakes the server up before the player enters the game.
faq.do_i_need_an: Do I need an API key for Modrinth or CurseForge?
faq.no_both_modrinth_and: No. Both Modrinth and CurseForge support are pre-configured and bundled directly into Zircon. Server owners and players can search, download, and sync mods from both platforms immediately with zero API keys or manual setup required.
faq.will_there_be_managed: Will there be managed cloud hosting (Zircon Cloud)?
faq.yes_managed_zerohardware_hosting: Yes, managed zero-hardware hosting with proprietary Pause-to-Sleep retention is planned on our future roadmap. Today, Zircon Launcher and the self-hosted Server Manager are 100% free, source-available, and ready for you to run on your own PC, homelab, or VPS at zero cost.
faq.is_my_microsoft_minecraft: Is my Microsoft Minecraft account safe?
faq.yes_authentication_is_performed: Yes. Authentication is performed via standard Microsoft OAuth 2.0 PKCE in your system web browser. Your credentials are submitted directly to Microsoft login servers. Zircon never sees, handles, or stores your Microsoft password.
faq.is_zircon_free_and: Is Zircon free and open source?
faq.yes_zircon_is_free: Yes, Zircon is free and source-available under the Business Source License 1.1 (BSL 1.1). The entire codebase (companion launcher and self-hosted server manager) is available for public inspection, auditing, and personal/community deployment on GitHub.
faq.are_downloaded_mods_verified: Are downloaded mods verified for safety?
faq.yes_mod_files_are: Yes. Mod files are verified using SHA-512 cryptographic hashes and CurseForge murmur2 fingerprints against official Modrinth and CurseForge APIs before they are ever placed in your active instance folder.
faq.windows_smartscreen_says_windows: Windows SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC" — what should I do?
faq.this_is_standard_for: This is standard for new open-source software that has not yet built up Microsoft SmartScreen certificate reputation. Click More info and then click Run anyway. You can also inspect the full source code on GitHub for transparency.
faq.do_i_need_to: Do I need to install Java manually?
faq.no_zircon_automatically_detects: No. Zircon automatically detects your system Java, and if a required version (e.g. Java 17 or Java 21) is missing, it downloads and caches the verified Eclipse Temurin JDK from Adoptium automatically.
faq.how_do_i_allocate: How do I allocate more RAM to modded Minecraft?
faq.in_the_zircon_launcher: In the Zircon Launcher, click the Settings icon in the sidebar. Use the memory allocation slider to adjust allocated RAM (4 GB to 8 GB is recommended for medium-to-large modpacks).
